description: SYNTHETIC role-play (invented, fictional people; written for testing). Poor MI practice: Persuade and Confront.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hi. My wife asked me to come and talk about my drinking, so here I am.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's get started. How many drinks do you have a night?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: A couple of glasses of wine, usually. It helps me unwind after work.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A couple? People always say a couple. I doubt that's the real number. How about being honest with me?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, maybe closer to four. But I don't think it's a big problem. I never miss work.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Four glasses a night is a problem, and you need to cut it down right away. Alcohol will wreck your liver and your sleep.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I hear that a lot, honestly. I'm just not sure I'm ready to stop completely.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Not ready? Then what are you doing here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's not fair. I came because my wife asked me to. She worries.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your wife is right to worry. Here is what you should do: pour out everything in the house and go to a meeting every night.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That seems like a lot. I don't know if I can do that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The guidelines say men should have no more than fourteen units a week. Do you know how many units that is?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not really, no. I guess it's less than I have.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's a lot less. Do you drink on weekends too? Do you drink alone? Do you drink before noon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Weekends, yes. Alone, mostly. Not before noon, no.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You drink alone every night and you think that's fine?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I never said it was fine. I just don't know what else to do at night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Plenty of people manage without drinking, so you can too. Just stop.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It sounds easy when you say it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It is easy if you want it badly enough. Maybe you don't.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I do want to. I'm tired of feeling guilty.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. Write down every drink for the next month and bring it back, no excuses.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Fine. I'll try.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Come back next week. Don't miss the appointment.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay.
